name: hoarding_dragon_a_returned_dragon_forgets_its_first_card
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature enters, you may search your library for an artifact card, exile it, then shuffle. When this creature dies, you may put the exiled card into its owner's hand.' The two abilities are linked (CR 607.2a), and a permanent that leaves the battlefield and comes back is a new object (CR 400.7). Hoarding Dragon enters and exiles the first artifact; it is returned to its owner's hand and enters again, exiling the second artifact. When it dies, only the card this object exiled (the second) can go to hand: the first stays in exile for good. Engine wave E1 keyed IS_EXILED_WITH_SOURCE to the reading ability's life (before, both returned: stronger than printed).
